avalanche.travel_advice: Watch for signs of unstable snow such as recent avalanches, cracking in the snow, and audible collapsing. Avoid traveling on or under similar slopes.

facts.text: Snow left Mckenzie (4,770 ft) 59 days earlier this year than the median of the three earlier seasons on file (2023 to 2025).

evidence.name: Mckenzie
evidence.detail: left April 6; earlier seasons: June 4 (2023), June 8 (2024), May 29 (2025)

facts.text: At Mckenzie (4,770 ft), this year's highest snow water on or after April 1 was 2.6 in, the lowest of the four seasons on file (2023 to 2026).

evidence.name: Mckenzie
evidence.detail: 2.6 in on April 16; earlier seasons: 41.6 in (2023), 39.5 in (2024), 44.3 in (2025)

facts.text: An estimate: snow left the pass itself between April 6 and June 20, carried from the melt-out date at Mckenzie (4,770 ft) to the pass elevation.

evidence.name: Mckenzie
evidence.detail: melted out April 6, 2,136 ft below the pass; points to April 6 to June 20
